title: salix × rubra subsp. forbyana
intro: Salix × rubra subsp. forbyana, commonly known as Willow bark or Red willow, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that is a hybrid of Salix alba and Salix fragilis. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and lowering fever. The therapeutic actions of Salix × rubra subsp. forbyana include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as salicin, a compound that is similar to aspirin. The bioactive constituents of Salix × rubra subsp. forbyana also include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
